propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without any retry wrapper, missing the transient read-fault recovery that other store write paths inherit through gitutil.run_git_write

A git object becomes temporarily unreadable on the runner filesystem between when s3_doctor attempts to bundle a merged commit and when the bundle call tries to parse it, causing 'fatal: bad object HEAD' errors in CI runs 31340000912, 31349549323, and 31558315198

The error message 'fatal: bad object HEAD' indicates the object was absent from the object database at bundle time, not unresolvable or corrupt, as proven by systematic testing of git error signatures
s3_doctor must route through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit the per-store advisory git-op lock, bounded index/ref-lock retry, and transient read-fault retry that prevent this fault class elsewhere
The transient-marker family in gitutil must be extended with the proven missing-object signature ('bad object') so the observed fault self-heals without introducing a new retry loop or policy
